description: Domain classification for Cornell/LII Markdown source materials. A source may appear in multiple domains when the legal text is relevant to multiple regulated CX workflows.

banking.notes: Banking customer operations: Reg E, ECOA/adverse action, TISA disclosures, GLBA information safeguards/privacy, CIP, and consumer-report adverse action obligations.

telecom.notes: Telecom account security: number portability, CPNI safeguards, truth-in-billing, SIM/port-out/Safe Connections related source material.

insurance.notes: Insurance claim-intake benchmark policy currently combines available LII financial privacy/consumer-report sources with curated insurance claim-flow compliance seeds.

healthcare.notes: Healthcare appeal and PHI workflows: ACA internal appeals/external review, HIPAA authorization/minimum necessary, nondiscrimination/meaningful access, and continuity/prospective review source material.

utilities.notes: Utilities disconnection and payment workflows: Texas bill payment, disconnection, reliability/continuity source material in the current raw corpus.

government_benefits.notes: Government benefits appeal workflows: SNAP notice/fair hearing, SSI notice, Medicaid hearing/continued services/renewal, disability and language access, and nondiscrimination source material.
